crossRefs.note: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but…
Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother…
While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t…
and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this…
Yahweh of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women…
He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t…
Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,
translations.bsb: When Jesus entered the house of the synagogue leader, He saw the flute players and the noisy crowd.
translations.kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
translations.asv: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the flute-players, and the crowd making a tumult,
